findings.comment: "Returns `Some(value)` wrapping `underlying.get`" is slightly awkward — `value` is an undeclared placeholder, and "wrapping" is redundant once you have `Some(...)`. Cleaner: "Returns `Some(underlying.get)` if it is non-null, or `None` otherwise."
`NoSuchElementException` is a code reference and should be in backticks: `NoSuchElementException`.
The comment is a single very long line (~160 chars). Wrap after the first clause so the source is readable without horizontal scrolling, e.g. break before "or `false`".
